completeness.why: All five linkers keep only their provider-specific bank lookup and pass their own account fields to linkAccountAndSync, which owns upgrade-or-insert (with the missing-account throw), the transfer payee, the initial sync, handleSyncResponse and the sync event; the file id and Akahu's tables are explicit arguments, and the unreachable id == null check is dropped.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations (account fields incl. GoCardless mask/official_name, optional fileId for Pluggy.ai, tables for Akahu), but the sync-source union is hand-written instead of using BankSyncProviders and the conditional spread for fileId is an awkward way to preserve the call arity.
